en.headline: Police treat fire that burned nine bicycles in Hang Hau as arson
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished the blaze at a public bicycle parking bay on Po Ning Road shortly after 1am; no one was injured and no arrests have been made.
body: Police are investigating a suspected arson after nine bicycles were burned at a public parking bay on Po Ning Road in Hang Hau, Tseung Kwan O, early this morning.

A passer-by reported the fire at about 1:12am. Firefighters arrived and put out the blaze. Initial inquiries found that nine bicycles had been destroyed. Fire services believed the cause was suspicious, and the case has been classified as arson.
No one was injured and no evacuation was required. Police have not yet made any arrests. The Tseung Kwan O District Crime Unit is following up the investigation.
Authorities said they would continue inquiries into the incident. Anyone with information is urged to contact police.

zh.headline: 將軍澳寶寧路公共單車泊位9輛單車焚毀 警列縱火案追查
zh.dek: 凌晨約1時有途人發現單車起火，消防員將火救熄，現場9輛單車被毀，暫無人被捕。
body: 將軍澳坑口寶寧路25號一個公共單車泊位今早凌晨發生火警，9輛單車被燒毀，警方將案件列作縱火跟進。
有途人於凌晨約1時12分發現停泊的單車起火並報案。消防員到場將火救熄，初步調查顯示共9輛單車燒毀，消防相信起火原因有可疑。
事件中無人受傷，亦毋須疏散。警方暫未有人被捕，案件交由將軍澳警區刑事調查隊跟進。
警方表示會繼續調查，呼籲市民如有資料可向警方提供。
